policy_metadata.policy_title: Reimbursement Level of Certain Evaluation and Management (E/M) Services

sections.heading: Overview
content: This policy establishes Humana's reimbursement for higher-level evaluation and management (E/M) services in the code set for office or other outpatient services.

sections.heading: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
content: In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. The following policy applies to only professional services. Humana reviews the higher-level office or other outpatient E/M services, CPT codes 99204, 99205, 99214 and 99215, to determine the level for reimbursement. Humana determines the reimbursement level based on the severity of the patient’s condition. When the billed E/M service code is higher than what is supported by the claim diagnosis coding, Humana adjusts reimbursement to the E/M service level determined by the review.
